title: Advisor
scopeHint: Project entries replace advisors with the same name from less specific files.
savedNotApplied: New chats read these settings. Apply them to this chat when omp is ready.
saveHint: Saving applies this scope through omp's own advisor editor. The advisor's current on or off state stays unchanged.
idleHint: Stop the current turn before applying advisor changes.
error: Could not read the advisor configuration
emptyHint: omp uses the advisor model role when no roster is configured. Add an advisor to set its cadence and tools.
name: Name
modelHint: Leave this empty to use the advisor role. omp also accepts role aliases and a :thinking suffix.
intervalHint: Skipped updates are included in the next scheduled review.
catchupHint: Numeric thresholds wait for at most 30 seconds. Strict waits for all scheduled reviews without a time limit. Stopping or a failure releases the wait.
defaultToolsHint: The default investigative tools are read, grep and glob, plus recall when available. An empty selection disables investigative tools. The advisor can still submit review notes.
instructionsHint: These instructions are added to the shared baseline. omp expands @imports when loading them.
sharedHint: These instructions join the shared baseline for all advisors in this chat.
notesHint: Leave this empty to inherit. Blocker notes are exempt.
discardBody: The changes in this sheet have not been saved.
dirtyScope: Save or reload this file before changing scope.
invalidName: Give each advisor a name. Names that resolve to the same omp slug must be unique in this file.
invalidNumber: Review intervals and note limits must be positive whole numbers.

mode.budget: Enter a positive token budget, such as 100000 or 100k.
mode.count: Enter a positive whole number of loop iterations.
mode.duration: Enter a positive loop duration, such as 10m or 1h30m.
mode.until: Enter the shell command that ends the loop when it succeeds.
mode.while: Enter the shell command that keeps the loop running while it succeeds.
